# Skyeblock

> Skyeblock is a creative studio that turns curiosity into digital products, stories, and experiences across care, learning, and exploration.

Canonical website: https://skyeblock.com/
Primary language: Traditional Chinese
Available interface languages: Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese
Contact: Skyeblock@gmail.com

## Projects

- MythFog — A location-based exploration product that reveals the world's fog through walking. https://www.mythfog.com/
- HENI Care — A planned care product for recording pain, food, medication, and mood. Not yet available. https://henicare.com/
- History 101 — A live educational product for exploring events across places, time, and relationships. Sign-in is required. https://history101.skyeblock.com/
- GeneDex — A concept in development for adopting genes awaiting research. Registration is not open.

## Other work

- Avatar Medicine Forum — A past forum about avatar medicine; BAYC #8796 served as MC in 2022 and 2023.
- APE 101 × CancerFree — An archived charity merchandise collaboration.
- 病了才知道 — A Traditional Chinese health podcast featuring doctors, dietitians, and health specialists.
- 精準健康嘉年華 2026 — An event organized by CancerFree Biotech, October 17–18, 2026, at Songshan Cultural and Creative Park in Taipei.
